WITH paid_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id, items_ex_vat
  FROM orders
  WHERE status = 'PAID'
    AND paid_at IS NOT NULL
    AND strftime('%m', paid_at) IN ('02', '03')
),
refunds_net AS (
  SELECT r.order_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_type = 'FULL' THEN o.items_ex_vat
                  ELSE r.refund_amount / 1.1 END) AS net
  FROM refunds r
  JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.status = 'PAID'
    AND o.paid_at IS NOT NULL
    AND strftime('%m', o.paid_at) IN ('02', '03')
  GROUP BY r.order_id
)
SELECT round(
  (
    (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(items_ex_vat), 0) FROM paid_orders)
    - (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(net), 0) FROM refunds_net)
  )
  /
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paid_orders)
) AS avg_order_amount

SELECT ROUND(
  COALESCE(refund_sum, 0) * 100.0 / COALESCE(order_sum, 1),
  2
) AS refund_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(o.items_ex_vat) AS order_sum,
    SUM(
      CASE r.refund_type
        WHEN 'FULL' THEN o.items_ex_vat
        WHEN 'PARTIAL' THEN r.refund_amount / 1.1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS refund_sum
  FROM orders o
  LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
  WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', o.paid_at) = '2026-02'
  GROUP BY 1
)
